📌 PROMPT FOR CREATING THE BUDGET SYSTEM – LUZ ILUMINAÇÃO

Create a complete web application using only HTML, CSS, and pure JavaScript, without frameworks, with a modern, elegant, friendly, and intuitive design, focused on creating and managing lighting budgets.

⚠️ IMPORTANT

All visible texts, labels, messages, field names, buttons, and printed content must be written in Portuguese (PT-BR).

All code comments (HTML, CSS, and JavaScript) must also be written in Portuguese (PT-BR).

Only the technical instructions and structure described in this prompt are in English.

🎨 DESIGN AND VISUAL IDENTITY

Color palette based on black, gray, and white, with subtle tone variations (light gray, medium gray, dark gray) to create depth, visual hierarchy, and a modern look.

Clean, minimalist, and professional interface.

Modern and highly readable typography.

Inputs and buttons with proper spacing, soft shadows, and smooth transitions.

Fully responsive layout.

Use the official company logo in the header:

http://luziluminacao.com.br/logo-branca.png

🏢 COMPANY INFORMATION (BUDGET HEADER)

Display the following information at the top of the budget:

LUZ ILUMINACAO COMERCIO DE ARTIGOS DE ILUMINACAO LTDA
Rua Barão de Souza Leão, Nº 1139, Recife/PE

Telefones:
(81) 9 9540-4746
(81) 9 9186-3342
(81) 9 9540-9330

(All texts above must be displayed in PT-BR exactly as written.)

💾 STORAGE

The entire project must work 100% using LocalStorage.

Display a clear and friendly message informing the user that:

“Os orçamentos ficam armazenados no navegador para futuras edições.”

No data must be lost when the page is refreshed or reopened.

🔢 BUDGET NUMBER GENERATION

Nº do Orçamento field must be generated automatically.

It must contain 6 characters, composed of:

1 uppercase letter (A–Z)

5 numbers (0–9)

The position of the letter and numbers must be automatic and random.

A new number must be generated every time a new budget tab is created.

Minimize numbering conflicts as much as possible.

👤 CLIENT INFORMATION

Required fields (all user input must be forced to CAPSLOCK):

Nome do Cliente

CPF/CNPJ (with mask and validation)

Endereço

E-mail (with proper format validation)

Telefone (with mask: (xx) x xxxx-xxxx)

Arquiteto

Vendedora (select field with fixed options):

Naqueline

Mylena

Yasmin

Observações do pedido (textarea)

(All field labels must be in PT-BR.)

📋 BUDGET ITEM LIST

Dynamic table containing:

Nº do item (starting at 1)

Descrição do produto

Quantidade

Valor Unitário (R$)

Desconto por item (%)

Valor Total do Item (R$ – automatically calculated)

Rules:

Item total = Quantity × Unit Price – Discount

All automatically calculated fields must be disabled (readonly) to prevent accidental editing.

Provide a button or command to add new items dynamically.

🧮 BUDGET TOTALS

Clearly display:

Sum of all item values (R$)

Total quantity of all items

Field to apply a global discount (%) to the total budget

Final total value of the budget (R$)

All currency values must display R$ (Brazilian Real).

🗂 TAB SYSTEM

Each budget must be opened in an internal tab system.

All tabs and their data must be stored in LocalStorage.

When creating a new tab:

Automatically generate a new random budget number.

Allow switching between tabs without losing any data.

🔍 BUDGET SEARCH

Global search bar.

Must locate budgets by:

Client name

Client phone number

Real-time search through stored data.

🏷 BROWSER TAB TITLE

The page <title> must be dynamically updated to include:

Budget number

Client name (as soon as it is typed)

This helps identify the correct budget among multiple browser tabs.

🖨 PRINT AND EXPORT

Button to print the current budget (with a print-friendly layout).

Button to save the budget as a PDF.

Printed and PDF layouts must be clean, professional, and well-organized.

🔄 EXPORT / IMPORT BUDGETS

Provide an option to:

Export a budget as a .json file

Import a .json budget file

Ensure no data loss when importing into another browser or device.

📎 IMPORTANT NOTE

I will attach a budget model only as a visual reference, however:

The entire layout, structure, and interface must be improved.

The final result must be more modern, elegant, intuitive, and professional than the provided model.

⚠️ GENERAL RULES

All user-editable fields must force CAPSLOCK input.

Friendly visual validations.

Clean, modular, and well-organized code.

All comments in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript must be written in Portuguese (PT-BR).
